meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Handles annotated matrices in single-cell analysis, .h5ad and Zarr files, and integration with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 存储和读取单细胞测序的矩阵数据,衔接下游分析流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 Python 里处理单细胞测序数据,需要统一格式来读写与共享。
copy.tagline_en: Store and read single-cell matrices in standard formats for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell sequencing data in Python and need a shared file format.

howto.what: 处理带注释的数据矩阵：创建 AnnData 对象，读写 .h5ad、Zarr 等文件，拼接多份数据、按条件取子集，也能用 backed 模式打开大文件。
howto.when: 当你要读写 .h5ad 或 Zarr 文件、拼接多份数据集、或处理大文件时接管；它只管数据格式，分析流程交给 scanpy。

say.text: 这个 100GB 的 h5ad 用 backed 模式打开，只看质量好的细胞

howto.what_en: Handles annotated data matrices: creates AnnData objects, reads and writes .h5ad and Zarr files, concatenates datasets, subsets by metadata, and opens large files in backed mode.
howto.when_en: Use it when reading or writing .h5ad / Zarr files, concatenating datasets, or handling large files. It covers the data format only; use scanpy for analysis workflows.
